notes.title: Version 2.9
notes.content:
Added a blue name for players with all medals.
Fixed a bug where the Baron wouldn't spawn in the middle of the island.
Adjusted the point for elite classes.
Adjusted the appearance of elite classes.
Adjusted the King market.
Made some optimizations.
Added the Season market.
Adjusted the Season.
Added a Snowball Cannonball. (Freezes the player for 2.5 seconds with a 25% chance)
Blessing of the Depths has been added. (Gives 10,000 health and removes negative effects when used.)

notes.title: Version 2.8
notes.content:
Added a 15-minute time limit to the Tortuga.
Fixed a speed stone display bug.
Added multiple logbooks to the login screen.
Added a limit on consecutive healing cannonball shots.
Updated the chat interface.
Added a timestamp to the rewards received in the logbook.
Increased daily login rewards.
Added the option to maximize or minimize the interface.
The Spy screen has been added to the Server dashboard tab.
Updated the Starter Pack.
Changed the location of the islands.
Added new Battle ships.
Added new Elite ships.
Changed Elite point rewards.
Added the ability to connect to the test server.
Added the Conqueror (1453) Event.

notes.title: Version 2.3
notes.content:
Server optimized.
Fixed text bug.
Added bonus map exit feature.
Increased skill save count from 3 to 4.
Reduced base speed by 1.
Added Flying Dutchman ship.
Added smoke effect to medal ships.
Event cannonball now gives 5 elite points instead of 4.
Medals of players with medals appear below the ship.
Added ice rocket. (Gives 5 elite points)
Added bone event.

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
Event calendar text error fixed.
Protected ship cannot throw bombs and is not damaged by bombs.
Protected ship cannot attack baron.
Chat-Bot system improved.
Gold error related to fleet bank fixed.
Chat size can be adjusted for computer.
Added ability to go to location after using spy.
Youtube ship added.
Elite ships added.

notes.title: Version 1.8
notes.content:
Fixed text bug.
The island will give a bonus if it has 12 towers.
A bug related to building towers has been fixed.
A new bonus map has been added (Gojo).
A feature has been added to bonus maps.
When the island is captured, it will come as 2 towers instead of 6.
A fleet baron has been added.
The compass will not show the location of the sunken player.
A new event has been added.

notes.title: Version 1.7
notes.content:
Fixed text bug.
Bonus map added. (Maki map).
Added bonus map piece to Cursed Captain.
Added limit for taking islands. A fleet will have a maximum of 4 islands.

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.content:
Fixed the premium date text issue.
Elite classes now give 3 cannons per level instead of 2.
New elite ships have been added.
Fixed the bug where the ship was not visible after map jumping.
Fixed the issue where the ship appeared in a different location after map jumping.
Map jump duration reduced from 2 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
Ship movement code for mobile has been adjusted.
Iron cannonball damage reduced from 45 to 10.
Fire cannonball will deal 25% more damage to fleet towers.
Range items in the bag increased from 5 minutes to 15 minutes.
Protection item has been adjusted; it now provides protection up to the 5th map, and the cooldown is 4 hours.
Quick repair time reduced from 20 seconds to 15 seconds.
Premium repair amount increased by 1%.
Fixed the profile interface display issue.
Maps 9 and 10 have been added.
The feature to see all seas in blue color has been added.
Daily quest rewards have been increased.
Carnis fleet tower health reduced from 24M to 20M.
Carnis fleet tower cost increased from 6M to 9M.
Fleet tower construction time increased from 25 minutes to 30 minutes.
Players can now name the talent save page.
Stealing limit added: 25 steals per day.
When a player’s ship sinks, it will no longer automatically respawn after 10 seconds.
Added the ability to log in using a username or email.
New data has been added to the profile.
Gold, silver, and bronze ships have been adjusted.
The admiral’s damage in maps 1 and 2 has been reduced.
Fixed the issue where the ship appeared as "Tarsier" on iOS.
Event added.

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Joystick added for mobile.
Mobile menu interface edited.
Anti-bot system improved.
Bug in name section fixed when creating a clan.
Skill interface edited.
Chat background edited.
Island bonuses will be visible in fleet page.
New key assignment feature added to CRTL key.
Stack key edited.
Lock added to computer menu hotbar.
New keys added to keyboard key menu.
Fleet name can have spaces.
Admiral counter on map increased to 300.
Announcement is made when Admiral appears.
Safe map admirals have reduced their health.
High level players cannot attack safe map admirals.
Admiral will spawn in the location of last killed NPC.
Automatic rocket added.
Automatic attack edited.
Interface edited for computer.
4 seconds time added for map jumping.
Stacking made easier on mobile.
Fleet island sizes reduced.
Fleet islands strengthened.
Calendar added to fleet logbook.
Fleet towers attack mechanism has changed. 
Fleet experience ranking has been added.
Removed water appearing when hitting a fleet tower.
Fixed a textual bug related to the registration date.
Fleet diplomacy has been edited.
Edited the location code where the player spawns after sinking.
Ares attack mechanism has been edited.
Added a detection system related to emulators.
Reduced the healing cannonball in season missions from 10,000 to 2,500.
Fixed a textual error that showed the same damage twice.
The map where you received the daily mission will be visible on the mission board.
Added spy.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
Admiras' health increased.
Admiral counter decreased from 300 to 200.
Value of all chests increased by 2 times.
Negative health will not come out of fortune chest.
12-hour text in daily mission fixed.
Shield icon was displayed when NPC was damaged fixed.
Chat became level 2 instead of level 3.
Admiral will be Orange on mini map.
Ships turning upside down issue fixed.
Interface will not close while developing skills.
Bot control spawn time extended.
Bot control numbers decreased from 4 digits to 3 digits.
3. Map NPC will not be stolen.
Text errors fixed.
Space issue fixed while entering code.
Added that if you click on the target by clicking the left CTRL key, it will go right to it.
Quick repair became gold instead of diamonds.
Fleet-creating costs increased from 2000 diamonds to 10,000 diamonds.
NPC range decreased.
Fixed the issue where the ship would move while writing in chat.
Fixed the issue where battle points would not be gained.
Range skill will give 1 range instead of 0.5 range.
Healing cannonball will not be spent on a player with full health.
Single cannon shooting disabled.
Quick repair and Speed ​​stone usage bug fixed.
Admiral spawning in wrong location fixed.
Market prices adjusted, reduced by 3-5 times.
Gold and diamond package added.
Textual error regarding fleet book fixed.
Event added.
